title: Bariatric Surgery for Treatment of Co-Morbid Conditions Related to Morbid Obesity

bmi.description: Body-mass index in kg/m2 as documented (not computed from weight alone)

obesity_comorbidity.description: At least one co-morbidity related to obesity is documented (e.g. type 2 diabetes, hypertension, obstructive sleep apnea, hyperlipidemia, osteoarthritis, GERD)

prior_medical_treatment_failed.description: Previously unsuccessful with medical (non-surgical) treatment for obesity, e.g. diets or programs without sustained weight loss

criteria.policy_text: covered for Medicare beneficiaries who have a body-mass index ≥ 35
have at least one co-morbidity related to obesity (Type 2 diabetes mellitus is a co-morbidity for purposes of this NCD)
have been previously unsuccessful with medical treatment for obesity
